work.name: Bosch China
work.summary: Deep Learning-based Gesture Recognition Algorithm Development
highlights: Developed gesture recognition algorithms for Human-Vehicle Interaction using DNN.
Applied the attention network to the neural network for dynamic gesture classification.
Achieved 90% accuracy for 16 static gestures and 9 dynamic gestures on webcam with 720p@30fps.

projects.name: Reverse-Engineering Insight Formation from Visualizations using Brain and Eye Signals
projects.summary: Advisors: Cindy Xiong Bearfield (Georgia Tech), Ratan Murty (Georgia Tech)
highlights: Investigating how low-level perceptual features interact with high-level reasoning processes in visualization comprehension.
Combining fMRI and eye-tracking to quantify perceptual and cognitive load across visual cortex and frontal cortex.
Developing a computational model to predict and interpret perceptual-cognitive demands from visualizations.

projects.name: VisChatter – Visual Annotations for Collaborative Analytics with Multimodality
projects.summary: Advisors: Cindy Xiong Bearfield (Georgia Tech), Tong Yu (Adobe)
highlights: Designed and implemented an interactive visualization dashboard with real-time annotation for synchronous collaborative analytics.
Integrated speech recognition, LLM-based keyword extraction, and custom annotation APIs for seamless multimodal input.
Conducted controlled A/B testing, measuring user engagement and task efficiency improvements.

projects.name: Interactive Web Integration for Gramm Visualizations in MATLAB
projects.summary: Advisors: Cindy Xiong Bearfield (Georgia Tech), Vijay Iyer (MathWorks), Pierre Morel (ULCO)
highlights: Extended Gramm, an open-source MATLAB visualization library, with a feature to export plots as interactive web visualizations.
Integrated Vega and SVG-based interactivity to enable zooming, panning, and tooltips directly in the browser.
Collaborated with the open-source community to design, implement, and document the new functionality.

projects.name: Assessing Immersiveness of Visual Storytelling in VR with Bio-signals
projects.summary: Advisors: Jeffery Riedmiller (Dolby Research), Cindy Xiong Bearfield (Georgia Tech)
highlights: Developed a pipeline to collect and analyze physiological signals during VR storytelling.
Piloting VR scenes varying in narrative structure and visual intensity.
Conducting data-driven evaluation of perceived immersion and emotional response.

projects.name: Vision Rehabilitation through Multisensory Interaction
projects.summary: Advisors: Tina Liu (Georgetown University), Cindy Xiong Bearfield (Georgia Tech)
highlights: Built interactive prototypes for training spatial attention and visual reconstruction.
Integrated visual and auditory cues to enhance sensory compensation and engagement.
Piloting test sessions with clinical collaborators to assess user feedback and accessibility.

projects.name: Assessing Cognitive Load of Word-scale Visualizations
projects.summary: Advisors: Marti Hearst (UC Berkeley), Cindy Xiong Bearfield (Georgia Tech)
highlights: Designed and executed a controlled eye-tracking study to assess how embedded visual embellishments affect reading comprehension across varied data densities.
Quantified cognitive disruption by analyzing psychophysiological metrics (eye saccades).
Explored word-scale visualization design guidelines for fluent reading flow.
